description: Runs make (GNU make) in a project folder inside the allowed folders, e.g. core_dump, to build it or run a target such as clean. Reports whether it succeeded and the output, including compiler errors.

params.name: path
params.description: Folder with the Makefile, starting with an allowed folder name, e.g. core_dump

params.name: target
params.description: Target to build, e.g. all or clean; omit it for the Makefile's default
